name: Alfasigma
event_blurb:
Morpho is the CDMO division of the Alfasigma Group, focused on providing integrated pharmaceutical development and manufacturing solutions. As a tech-driven specialty CDMO, Morpho combines advanced formulation expertise, innovative manufacturing technologies, and regulatory excellence to support partners from early development through commercial production.
Morpho operates through three complementary business units:
Pharma Tech: pharmaceutical development and manufacturing services, with expertise in complex dosage forms and advanced drug delivery technologies.
Fine Chemicals (Biosint): development and GMP manufacturing of APIs and fine chemicals.
Nutra & Medical Food (US): nutraceutical and medical food development and manufacturing capabilities in the United States.

name: CRAMSN Research Park at CRAMSN Research Park Private Limited
event_blurb: CRAMSN is a leading Contract Research, Development, and Manufacturing Organization (CRO, CDMO, CMO) that offers end-to-end solutions and supports standalone programs with efficiency, quality, and consistency enabling faster go-to-market strategies. As a catalyst for change, we are committed to reducing our carbon footprint through sustainable practices. Our objectives include utilizing green chemistry across our services to minimize our carbon footprint. Solar-powered facilities and maintaining 50% green cover help us move closer to achieving net-zero waste.

name: ESTEVE CDMO
event_blurb:
Esteve CDMO is a specialized partner for small molecule new chemical entity (NCE) innovators, supporting programs from early clinical development through to full commercial manufacturing. Focused on Phase I through commercialization, Esteve CDMO provides an integrated and scalable framework designed for emerging, mid-sized, and large pharmaceutical companies. With a worldwide network that includes six cGMP manufacturing sites across the US, China, Mexico, and Spain, and key technologies such as HPAPI OEB5 containment and spray drying, Esteve CDMO combines global reach, regulatory alignment, and supply continuity to support partners in advancing their products at every stage of development.

name: FIS
event_blurb: FIS is a top 5 global CDMO for small molecule Drug Substance, with over 70 years of experience in tech transfer, process optimization, scale up, and validation. Our 25+ scientist industrialization team is backed by three closely-clustered Italian sites and dedicated early- and late-phase R&D, with a high ratio of analysts to chemists and 99% of testing conducted in-house. We bring deep expertise in spray drying, flow chemistry, and liquid phase peptide synthesis. Backed by Bain Capital, FIS continues to invest in capacity and technology to support partners from development through commercial scale.

name: Grand River Aseptic Manufacturing
event_blurb:
Grand River Aseptic Manufacturing (GRAM) is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) specializing in sterile injectable fill-and-finish services for liquid and lyophilized vials, syringes, and cartridges. We are committed to advancing patient care by providing our clients with the experience, technology, and quality record necessary for effective clinical trials and successful commercialization.
GRAM adds value for our clients through strategic partnerships with innovators in drug delivery devices, offering tailored solutions designed for autoinjectors and on-body delivery systems. Our emphasis on collaboration allows us to speed up the delivery of innovative therapies, ensuring that our clients' products reach the market and benefit patients into the future.

name: Richman Chemical Inc. at Richman Chemical Inc.
Sai Life Sciences
event_blurb: Sai Life Sciences is built on the bedrock of partnership. We work with innovator pharma and biotech companies to accelerate the discovery, development and manufacture of complex small molecules for a healthier tomorrow. Our Vision is to support our global innovator partners bring 25 new medicines to life by 2025. And we are well on that journey.

name: SK Pharmteco
event_blurb: SK pharmteco is a leading global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with a network of CGMP facilities in key markets. Our experts and services empower our clients across the world, helping to bring innovative therapies to patients at any scale.

name: SUANFARMA
event_blurb:
Suanfarma CDMO - Your European Partner for Small Molecule Innovation
Suanfarma CDMO is a European Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization specializing in the development, scale-up and commercial manufacturing of small molecule APIs and advanced intermediates. We provide integrated solutions from early development through GMP manufacturing and commercial supply, supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies with customized, science-driven partnerships.
Our unique strength lies in combining advanced chemical synthesis, industrial bioconversion (fermentation), and flow chemistry expertise within a single development platform. This enables us to design efficient, scalable and sustainable manufacturing routes for complex molecules while accelerating technology transfer and reducing development risk.
